addition.item: Slideshow Pro gets the "Icon (Icon Pro)" field with the icon picker for its Arrow Icon and for the icons of both buttons of every slide.
Card Pro gets the "Icon (Icon Pro)" field with the icon picker, after its Icon field.
Alert Pro gets the "Icon (Icon Pro)" field with the icon picker, after its Icon field.

change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Grid columns work like YOOtheme's own elements: Phone Portrait, Phone Landscape, Tablet Landscape and Desktop, each with Inherit (the next smaller size) and "Fill the row equally". They replace Columns and Columns on Phones.

Settings renamed for consistency: Shape Size, On Hover and Keep Moving are now stored as shape_size, animate_hover and animate_loop. Older layouts are migrated automatically, with their column, shape and animation choices kept.
The icon field Icon Pro adds to other Elemen elements and to YOOtheme menu items is now called "Icon (Icon Pro)": it takes Lucide names, uikit: names and class: icon fonts.
The icon gallery's built-in search words are English. Malay search words moved to a separate file and are loaded when the Joomla administrator language is Malay.

fix.item: A ; or : in a tooltip no longer cuts the tooltip short.
Links that open in a new window get rel="noopener".
The screen reader name "Icon" for linked icon fonts and images comes from the language files.

addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the label, tooltip and link of all items without deleting them.

Icon fonts such as Flaticon UIcons, Font Awesome or Bootstrap Icons: add their stylesheet URLs in the plugin options (System → Plugins → Icon Pro), then write class: and the icon's classes in any icon field, e.g. class:fi fi-rr-home. The stylesheets load only on pages that show such an icon. Works in Icon Pro, in the Lucide Icon fields of the other elements and in YOOtheme menus. Colours (gradients fill the glyph), sizes, shapes, hover and looping animations apply; drawing, line weight and duotone are for Lucide icons.

Lucide icons in YOOtheme menus: menu items get a Lucide Icon field after their Icon field (with the icon picker), and the icon shows in every menu type (navbar, dropdown, offcanvas, icon nav, subnav) with the same size and spacing as YOOtheme's own icons.

change.item: The icon gallery and the builder's icon picker are in English only. Malay search words (rumah, kedai, telefon, …) still find icons.

fix.item: Icon picker in the builder: the gallery says that a click chooses the icon, the search box has the focus when it opens, and the close button no longer sits on the scroll bar.

addition.item: Icon picker in the builder: the "Open the icon gallery" link under an icon field opens the gallery in a dialog over the builder, and clicking an icon fills the field. Escape or a click outside closes it.
Lucide Icon fields for Heading Pro and Marquee Pro (item icon and separator icon).

Other Elemen elements can use Lucide icons: Icon Pro adds a Lucide Icon field after the icon fields of Counter Pro, Flip Box Pro (item icon and back list icon), Timeline Pro (marker icons) and Tabs Pro.

Icon gallery: the picked icon stays in a bar at the bottom, to copy its name, copy it as SVG or download an .svg file, in a chosen color and line weight, for YOOtheme's own elements (image fields, HTML element).

First release: Lucide 1.70.0 icons (2,029, plus 293 older names), UIkit icons and your own images, in a row or grid with labels, links, tooltips and their own colors. Shapes (circle, square, rounded, blob) that are filled, soft, outline or gradient, line weight, gradient and soft-fill icons. Icons that draw themselves, fade, zoom or rise into view, hover effects (spin, bounce, pulse, shake, lift, fill) and looping pulse, float, wiggle or morph. Only the icons used are in the page, as inline SVG. A searchable gallery with Malay and English words copies an icon's name.
